brief.headline: Cut our Dextrose price by 3.0% to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — they keep 8.5% profit so they can afford it, and we have three qualified alternates ready.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to drop Dextrose Anhydrous IP from ₹68.45/KG to ₹66.48/KG — the price Sayaji already gives us.
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (a 3.0% cut), saving us ₹1.26 Cr per year
priceAsk.basis: Sayaji Industries gives us the same material at ₹66.48/KG today. The open market typical band is ₹66–73/kg, so our ask sits at the low end of fair. They keep 8.5% of every sale as profit — plenty of room to meet our price without losing money.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days — no need to change it.

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja is a big, healthy company — ₹5995.63 Cr revenue, keeps 8.5% profit, and carries almost no debt (0.13x). We are a tiny 0.35% of their sales, so we have no volume leverage. But they keep a comfortable profit cushion, so a 3.0% price cut won't hurt them. The real lever is that they supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) and we now have three credible alternates lined up — Gulshan Polyols, Sanstar, and Tirupati Starch — so we can walk if they won't move. Push firmly on price; their finances can take it.

evidence.point: They keep a healthy profit — 8.5% of sales after all costs
We are a tiny customer to them
We pay them 3.0% more than Sayaji's price for the same Dextrose
Closing the gap to Sayaji's price saves us this much every year
They carry almost no debt — very low financial stress
The open market typical asking price band for Anhydrous Dextrose IP supports our target

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, ₹2437.35 Cr revenue, health score B (68/100) — established dextrose supplier, a strong drop-in alternate.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹842.97 Cr revenue, health C (52/100) — growing capacity in starch and dextrose.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue — makes Dextrose Anhydrous in IV-fluid grade (exact form match); confirm IP monograph certificate of analysis before switching.

risks: They supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — if talks break down we need the alternates qualified and ready fast, or we face a supply gap.
We are only 0.35% of their revenue — they don't need us, so frame the ask around fairness (matching Sayaji) and our plan to dual-source, not around how much we buy.
Gujarat Ambuja's overall health score is C (55/100) — mid-range — so while their profit is healthy, watch for any supply hiccups and keep the alternate pipeline active.
The market asking price band (₹60–81/kg, typical ₹66–73/kg) is wide; if they push back, be ready to show that Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG is real and that the open market supports it.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about bringing your Dextrose price in line with Sayaji's ₹66.48 per kilo — that's the benchmark we're working to across all our suppliers, and the market data backs it up.
